title: JobView
description: 200 body of GET /api/jobs/:id (job-status.mts) -> Console polling every 2-3 s (console/chat.js). Only the owner sees it (job.owner !== sub -> 404 not_found, so ids can't be probed). events are the SAME shapes as the SSE union, appended in order; text is stored per finished text block, not per token. The client renders events from the index it has already shown. Never returned: messages (conversation state), owner, nonceHash, baseSha. Contract: docs/design/build-contracts.md §5.

allOf.description: A finished job's last event is terminal: done (done) or error (failed). A paused job ends with done {stopReason: max_tokens|tool_rounds_exhausted} or no terminal event yet.
